Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown

Career Counselling Seminar – Guiding Students Towards a Brighter Future

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown extends its sincere thanks to Rtn Pranav Badheka for conducting a career counselling and guidance seminar for students of Standard XII.

The seminar aimed to motivate students at this important stage of their academic journey, helping them gain clarity about future opportunities and make informed decisions regarding their higher education and career paths.

Such initiatives provide valuable guidance, encourage students to explore their interests and strengths, and help them approach their future with greater confidence and purpose.

Through this initiative, Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown continues its commitment to youth development, education and empowering the next generation
